definitions.explanation: Beyond what is possible or reasonable.

examples.japanese: {今日中|きょうじゅう}に{終|お}わらせるのは{無理|むり}です。
examples.english: It's impossible to finish it today.

examples.japanese: その{計画|けいかく}は{予算|よさん}の{面|めん}で{無理|むり}があると{思|おも}います。
examples.english: I think that plan has problems budget-wise.

examples.japanese: {一人|ひとり}でやるのは{無理|むり}だから、{手伝|てつだ}ってくれる？
examples.english: It's impossible to do it alone, so could you help me?

examples.japanese: {無理|むり}しないでください。
{無理|むり}して{食|た}べなくていいよ。
examples.english: You don't have to force yourself to eat.

examples.japanese: {体調|たいちょう}が{悪|わる}いときは{無理|むり}をしないで{休|やす}んでください。
examples.english: When you're not feeling well, don't push yourself and please rest.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}いころは{無理|むり}がきいたが、{年|とし}を{取|と}ると{回復|かいふく}に{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: When I was young I could push myself, but as I get older it takes time to recover.

examples.japanese: {締|し}め{切|き}りに{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせるために{無理|むり}をして{徹夜|てつや}した{結果|けっか}、{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}してしまった。
examples.english: As a result of pushing myself and staying up all night to meet the deadline, I got sick.

notes:
{無理|むり} expresses impossibility, unreasonableness, or overexertion.

GRAMMATICAL FUNCTIONS:
- Noun: {無理|むり}だ (it's impossible)
- Na-adjective: {無理|むり}な{要求|ようきゅう} (unreasonable demand)
- Verbal: {無理|むり}する (to push oneself too hard)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {無理|むり}しないで: don't overdo it
- {無理|むり}を{言|い}う: to make unreasonable demands
- {無理|むり}がある: there are problems, it's unreasonable
- {無理|むり}もない: it's understandable

COMPOUNDS:
- {無理|むり}{矢理|やり}: forcibly, by force
- {無理|むり}{難題|なんだい}: unreasonable demand

CONTRAST:
- {無理|むり}: impossible, forced ↔ {可能|かのう}: possible
- {無理|むり}: unreasonable ↔ {当然|とうぜん}: natural, reasonable

NOTE:
{無理|むり}しないでね is a common expression of concern meaning "don't push yourself."
